scheme_name: Certification Program for Goan IT Professionals
other_conditions: Applicant must be of Goan origin.
Applicant must have qualifications suitable for employment in the IT industry.
Applicant's bank account must be linked to Aadhaar.
Certifications must be obtained from OEM vendors or their authorized training partners.
Certifications must be directly relevant to the IT industry.
Certification must be completed during the policy's operation period.
Only approved certifications (as listed) are eligible.
Application can be submitted quarterly, bi‑annually, or annually after incurring the expenditure.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to 50% of the expenditure incurred for obtaining IT‑related certifications.
